genres: Action; Adventure; Casual; Indie; Massively Multiplayer; Racing; RPG; Simulation; Strategy; Free To Play
short_description: Step into an open-world action-adventure RPG set in ancient China. Uncover the secrets of your own identity as you rise from a humble village wanderer to the sword master of the imperial capital. Learn martial arts and build your reputation as a hero or a bringer of chaos in this free wuxia world.
